title: 丽桑卓·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 巨大尖冠遮住双眼，浅蓝肌肤与融入冰层的黑青长裙相映。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Lissandra is a tall ice witch with a massive dark pointed crown covering her eyes, pale blue skin, flowing white hair, and a long black-teal gown merging with crystalline ice forms. Preserve the distinctive concealed-eye crown and elongated nonordinary silhouette while keeping all torso and limbs covered. The crystalline surfaces are controlled geometric facets, without frozen victims, threatening spikes, or attacking gestures.
art_direction.scene: A composed near-profile study with a gentle head turn, signature forms stacked into a tall diagonal, luminous rim and airy negative space. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: black teal, ice blue, silver white, pale gold edge; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
